resolution_alternatives.label: Review source-directed lexical links from data structure; links are model-local discovery evidence, not proposition truth or normative authority.
Review the bounded data-structure source context while preserving edge direction; browsing does not create an inverse fact, permission, or obligation.

abstain_or_escalate.label: Abstain or escalate when traversal coverage, source identity, or lexical authority is unresolved; never promote a WordNet link into proof or norm justification.

review_triggers: Missing source-directed traversal coverage or missing root node: abstain_or_escalate.
Changed OEWN source hash, bounded graph hash, retrieved snapshot, or adapter: re-run the review.
Ambiguous lexical mapping or an unlisted node: abstain_or_escalate.
Any attempt to treat a WordNet edge or evidence bit as proposition truth, proof, permission, obligation, or norm justification: reject and escalate.
